scope: Actual frozen LibraryManager.ResolvePaths and MovieResolver.GetMultiDiscMovie behavior for nested DVD and Blu-ray directory stacks. Records Disc/CD/DVD/disk tokens, numeric and alphabetic parts, extension-like suffixes, captured ASCII numeric ordering and a CurrentCulture punctuation-order primary identity boundary, concrete Movie/MusicVideo/Video types, VideoType, AdditionalParts, Folder fallback for invalid or mixed layouts, and the native qualified-stray edge. Only MovieResolver and FolderResolver are registered; items are resolved but not saved or recursively scanned. Broader case/non-ASCII and NLS-versus-ICU ordering, weak snapshots, deletion, reverse reclassification, provider refresh, migration and release acceptance are outside this recording.
